lines: // lineInput is the daemon's one reader of terminal stdin. run constructs it once and
// hands it to the two prompts that read a line — the save-port prompt while serving and
// the -on-exit prompt at shutdown — which never overlap: run ends the first
// (stopSavePrompt) before shutdown starts the second. mu guards pending, the only field
// written after construction; the bufio.Reader is touched by one read goroutine at a time
// because a new one starts only once pending is cleared. A read an earlier prompt gave up
// on stays in flight, and the next readLine collects its line instead of starting a
// second reader on the same file.
